en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy waterfront quay with several steamships docked and people walking along the pier. Early automobiles and carriages are visible on the open square beside a large classical building identified as the Nationalmuseum. The scene looks across the water towards wooded shores and distant city buildings. The caption at the bottom identifies the location in Stockholm, and a photographer/publisher credit appears in the lower right corner.
